# P10 · Teacher flows on both channels: lessons, reflections: v3 carry-over items

Created 2026-10-19 by the kit v3 migration (`docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`). Step B of the protocol merges these into the phase's full task list.

## v3 carry-over (added 2026-10-19, from `docs/build/reports/MIGRATION-v1-v3.md`)

- [ ] Flows T4 and T6, lessons as one `media` step per lesson (voice note in Telegram, cached lesson card in the PWA), the model run as a `media` step, "Rehearse this" `link`; two taps per lesson; optional voice reflection; biweekly "Still using it?" prompts that stop at the next check.
- [ ] Call 9 reflection pointer (`MODEL_POINTER`): register in `ai/registry.py`, add `c09_reflection_pointer.v1.md`, README table, names stripped first, validators (step id exists, verbatim quote, no numbers, length), pre-filter, call 7; any failure sends nothing. Test first: invented step id, non-verbatim quote, number, surviving name.
- [ ] `services/api/time_budget.py`: minutes per teacher per week against the 20-minute cap; content gate rejects a lesson over 5 minutes.
- [ ] Time-labelled self-report: taps and reflections are "self-report", deliveries "system"; never say "listened" or "watched".
